scope: Characterization only; no TV4 media adapter is implemented.

capabilities.actual_current_behavior: GET /videos/{video_id}/stream streams MediaRecord.original_video_path; HEAD returns metadata without a body.
capabilities.security_semantics: video_id is registry-keyed; unknown video_id is 404. The route trusts the registered absolute original_video_path.
capabilities.tv4_exposure: No /videos media route in tracked TV4 api.py.

capabilities.actual_current_behavior: Single byte ranges support closed, open-ended and suffix forms. Valid range GET is 206; malformed, multiple, wrong-unit, reversed and unsatisfiable ranges are 416 with Content-Range bytes */size.
capabilities.security_semantics: No-range GET is FileResponse with Accept-Ranges; HEAD is 200 with Accept-Ranges and Content-Length.

capabilities.actual_current_behavior: GET /frames/{frame_id}.jpg decodes from the original-frame record and returns image/jpeg with X-Original-Frame-Id, X-PTS, X-Timestamp-Ms. /resolve accepts nearest, before, after and returns the record with absolute_error_ms.
capabilities.security_semantics: Frame identity is resolver-record-backed and PTS-timeline-based; bad resolution mode is 422.
capabilities.tv4_exposure: No browser frame-image or resolve transport route in tracked TV4.

capabilities.actual_current_behavior: The stream route has no configured media root, resolved-path containment check, allowed-extension policy, or proxy selection/resolution behavior. It uses original_video_path directly and MIME is guessed from its name.
capabilities.security_semantics: Route-path traversal does not become a registry key (404), but a malicious/trusted-bad MediaRecord absolute path is streamable. A .txt record is also streamable. Thus containment, extension and symlink escape protections are not proven upstream and are T014 requirements.
capabilities.tv4_exposure: Absent; TV4 media_identity.py has a separate exact-neighbor registry resolver, not a browser transport endpoint.

capabilities.source_evidence: WP04 original-frame headers/FrameResolver; TV4 api.py::exact_frame_neighbors; TV4 exact_identity.py
capabilities.actual_current_behavior: Playback bytes and JPEG headers expose media metadata only. Canonical selection remains backend proof-based through the accepted exact-neighbor boundary; browser playback cannot create a canonical frame_id.
capabilities.security_semantics: No proxy-resolution behavior is implemented by the WP04 stream route; no new identity schema is inferred by T013.
capabilities.tv4_exposure: Only POST /exact-frame/neighbors exists for certified original-frame inspection; browser media transport is absent.

platform_note: T013 attempts a temporary symlink only when Windows permits it. If creation is denied, the test has no skip: it asserts the actual WP04 route lacks resolved-path containment, which is the relevant current security fact.
t014_requirements_observed: original identity preservation without playback-derived frame IDs
